posts.text: Last weekend, I had the privilege of attending QHacks 2026. The commute was long, but I knew immediately it was worth it. Over the weekend, we built RiskGuard, aiming to tackle the human element of market trading. Trading is widely considered to be ~80% psychology and ~20% strategy. Most traders don't fail because they lack data; they fail because of an irrational decision that spirals into revenge trading, over-leveraging, and breaking their own rules when emotions take control.
